summary: QXO filed an 8-K disclosing the release of an investor Q&A related to its pending acquisition of TopBuild Corp. The filing confirms QXO as the acquirer in a transformative deal. No specific financial terms (price per share, premium, or consideration form) are disclosed in this excerpt. The board recommends the transaction; no advisors are named. The filing is a Rule 425 communication under the Securities Act. The deal is pending shareholder and regulatory approvals, with risk factors including potential termination fees. What to watch: shareholder vote timing and regulatory clearance in building products sector.
